title: Red Hat Security Advisory: idm:client security update
description: Red Hat Identity Management (IdM) has multiple critical security vulnerabilities affecting authentication, authorization, and LDAP operations. These include unauthenticated denial of service via unbounded request body reads, privilege escalation through krbCanonicalName manipulation, unauthorized LDAP writes via trust relationships, cross-site scripting allowing arbitrary code execution, and unauthorized access to administrator credentials. The vulnerabilities impact FreeIPA components and trust relationships in IdM. Red Hat has issued security updates addressing these issues for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8.4 variants.
